name: Black Olive Pita Pizza Bento Box with Pineapple, Bell Pepper & Spinach Dip

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Transfer pita to a baking sheet pan. Spread with sauce, then top with cheese and drained olives.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 white pita bread
¼ cup pizza sauce
½ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend
½ (64 g) can sliced black olives

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cheese is melted, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, 20-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; slice lengthwise into thin strips. Place in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Place spinach dip in the first small compartment of the bento box.
Drain pineapple. Place in the second small compartment of the bento box.
When the pizza is cool, cut into wedges and place in the large compartment of the bento box.
Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
